name: house-style
description: Gaya desain pribadi: aturan landing page (struktur, copy, SEO, tipografi, spacing, radius, motion), aturan dashboard dan app (shell, tabel, filter, form, grafik, state), cara mendesain di Figma (variables, auto layout, komponen), peta pemilihan skill agensi, perintah /landing, /polish, /cek-ui, serta hook cek UI otomatis dengan Playwright. Prioritas utama di atas skill lain.
